user.text:
I want a small Next.js app for keeping track of the books I'm reading.

When I open it I want to see what I'm currently reading and what I've finished. I want to add a book from a form, mark one as finished, and click through to a book to see its title, author and my notes. I'd like to be able to send someone a link to a single book.

Nothing fancy and no accounts. Skip the database, save the books to a JSON file so they're still there after a restart.

history.assistant:
Built the Next.js reading tracker. The home page shows books you’re reading and books you’ve finished; you can add a book with notes, mark it finished, and open a shareable /books/[id] page. Books are saved in data/books.json, with no database or accounts.

Verification passed: npm run build, npm run typecheck, and npm test (1 test). An HTTP check confirmed the home page renders and an unknown book returns 404. Run it locally with npm run dev.

The JSON file persists across restarts when the app runs on a writable local filesystem.
